Description

Primary mission is to measure shock and vibration data during launch. We will be the first CubeSat to be powered on. We also are partnering with a 2U (University) CubeSat and will be wirelessly transmitting through RF our data to them during launch. Once we are ejected from the PPOD our mission is over. The University CubeSat will take a picture of us as we are ejected and then transmit our data to the ground for analysis.
Failure cause Was planned to be operational only during launch.
